controls: Same headless-shell executable and browser version
Identical source hashes, cast, cycle count and raw-CDP driver
Network.enable is the deliberate variable; Network.disable tests release within the same browser
findings: Without Network inspection, four released unique-cast partition allocations range from 3538944 to 3686400 bytes; corresponding private footprints range from 59967488 to 65226752 bytes.
With Network inspection, released partition allocations grow from 141541376 to 217284608 bytes. Neither critical memory pressure nor clearing browser cache releases that allocation.
Network.disable then releases 213630976 partition bytes and 212451328 private-footprint bytes in the same process.
The observed growing response-buffer allocation is observer-owned in this controlled study. Process RSS remains a different measure and is not used as proof of an application leak.
All public appearance caches/borrowed providers drain and isolated DOM counters return to baseline in both controls.
excludedExperiment: The initial regular-Chrome trial used a different binary and extra renderers; excluded from the matched comparison.
scope: Four shared and four unique twelve-resident public appearance-library cycles per control. Not full editor/game simulation, indefinite lifetime, all body families, physical-display performance or complete release acceptance.
remaining: Broader roster/body-family combinations and long-duration tests
Remaining art, usability and release requirements
